Full Stack Web Developer Intern (Paid)

Company: Zenithbyte

Location: Remote
Duration: 3 Months
For College Students Only!

Performance based stipend up-to 7500.00/-

This is a structured Career Launch Internship Program designed to help students gain practical project experience, mentorship, and industry exposure. The program includes guided learning resources, project evaluations, certificates, and performance-based opportunities.

Perks and benefits:

Performance based stipend up-to 7500.00/-

Certificate of Internship
Letter of Recommendation (based on performance)
Swags and goodies

Work on live projects involving both front-end and back-end development. Gain hands-on experience with modern web technologies and build strong technical skills.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain responsive websites
Build dynamic web applications
Test, debug, and optimize applications
Collaborate with designers and developers

Eligibility:

Students or recent graduates in Computer Science, IT, or related fields with knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Familiarity with React, Angular, or Node.js is preferred.

jobs.description:
Web Development Intern
Company:
UM IT PRIVATE LIMITED
Location:
Remote
Duration:
3 Months
Application Deadline:
20th August 2026

For College Students Only!

About UM IT PRIVATE LIMITED
UM IT PRIVATE LIMITED provides students and graduates with practical exposure to modern web development through real-world projects and industry mentorship. The program is designed to help aspiring developers build technical expertise, strengthen problem-solving skills, and gain experience with industry-standard tools and technologies.

Roles & Responsibilities

Develop and maintain responsive, user-friendly websites and web applications.
Build interactive front-end interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Assist in developing back-end functionalities and APIs.
Debug, test, and optimize applications for performance and scalability.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement responsive designs.
Work with version control systems such as Git and GitHub.
Participate in code reviews and follow industry best practices.
Collaborate with the development team on live client and internal projects.

Requirements

Enrolled in or recently graduated from Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Familiarity with responsive web design principles.
Basic knowledge of React, Angular, Vue.js, or similar front-end frameworks (preferred).
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

What You Will Gain

Hands-on experience working on live web development projects.
Swags and goodies.
Certificate of Internship upon successful completion.
Letter of Recommendation based on performance.
Mentorship from experienced developers.
Potential full-time role based on performance.
Performance-Based Stipend up to ₹7,500/month.

How to Apply

Submit your application with the subject line:
"Web Development Intern Application – UM IT PRIVATE LIMITED"

is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. We are committed to fostering diversity, inclusion, innovation, and professional growth for every intern.
